description_en: Queries the status and results of an intelligent production job
description_zh: 调用QueryIProductionJob查询智能生产任务状态与结果
name: QueryIProductionJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intelligent production job
parameters.name: job_id

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in GMT

FinishTime.description_en: The completion time. The time is displayed in GMT

FunctionName.description_en:
The name of the algorithm feature to be used. Valid values:

Cover: Intelligent cover.
VideoClip: Video summary.
VideoDelogo: Video icon removal.
VideoDetext: Video subtitle removal.
CaptionExtraction: Caption fetch.
VideoGreenScreenMatting: Image matting.
FaceBeauty: Video face beautification.
VideoH2V: Video horizontal-to-vertical conversion.
MusicSegmentDetect: Chorus detection.
AudioBeatDetection: Beat detection.
AudioQualityAssessment: Audio quality assessment.
SpeechDenoise: Speech noise reduction.
AudioMixing: Audio mixing.
MusicDemix: Vocal and accompaniment separation
FunctionName.description_zh:
需要使用的算法功能名称。取值：

Cover：智能封面
VideoClip：视频摘要
VideoDelogo：视频去图标
VideoDetext：视频去字幕
CaptionExtraction：字幕提取
VideoGreenScreenMatting：绿幕抠图
FaceBeauty：视频美颜
VideoH2V：视频横转竖
MusicSegmentDetect：副歌检测
AudioBeatDetection：节奏检测
AudioQualityAssessment：音质检测
SpeechDenoise：语音降噪
AudioMixing：音频混音
MusicDemix：声伴分离

Media.description_en:
The input media. If Type is set to OSS, enter the OSS URL. If Type is set to Media, enter the media asset ID. The OSS URL must be in one of the following formats:
oss://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
In the URLs, bucket is the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
Media.description_zh:
输入媒体。当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址，Type为Media时填入媒资ID。
OSS地址规则为：
oss://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径

Type.description_en:
The input type. Valid values:
OSS: the URL of an Object Storage Service (OSS) object.
Media: the ID of a media asset
Type.description_zh:
输入类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID

JobParams.description_en: The algorithm job parameters. The value is a JSON object. The parameters vary based on the algorithm
JobParams.description_zh: 算法作业参数，JSON对象，不同算法对应参数内容不同

Biz.description_en: The business to which the media asset belongs

Media.description_en:
The output media. If Type is set to OSS, the OSS URL is returned. If Type is set to Media, the specified media asset ID or a newly generated media asset ID is returned. The OSS URL must be in one of the following formats:
oss://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
In the URLs, bucket is the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
Media.description_zh:
输出媒体。当Type为OSS时返回OSS地址，Type为Media时返回指定的媒资ID或新生成媒资ID。

OSS地址规则为：
oss://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径

OutputUrl.description_en: The OSS URL of the specified output file when Type is set to Media
OutputUrl.description_zh: 当Type=Media时，为指定输出文件OSS地址

Type.description_en:
The media type. Valid values:
OSS: the OSS path.
Media: the media asset ID
Type.description_zh:
媒体类型：
OSS：OSS路径
Media：媒资ID

items.description_en: The path and name of the generated file
items.description_zh: 生成的文件路径与名称

OutputUrls.description_en: The array of output file URLs

items.description_en: The accessible URL of the generated file
items.description_zh: 生成的文件可访问URL路径

Result.description_en: The result information output by the algorithm. The output varies based on the FunctionName and is returned in JSON format. For more information, see the following supplementary descriptions
Result.description_zh: 算法输出的结果信息，不同FunctionName的输出不同，以JSON格式输出，详见下面的补充说明

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the job in its corresponding pipeline.

Highest priority: 10.

Default value: 6
Priority.description_zh:
任务在其对应管道内的优先级。

最高优先级：10。

默认值：6

Status.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:
Queuing: The job is queued.
Analysing: The job is being analyzed.
Fail: The job failed.
Success: The job succeeded
Status.description_zh:
作业状态。取值：
Queuing：排队中。
Analysing：分析中。
Fail：失败。
Success：成功

UserData.description_en: The custom user data. The data is returned as is when the results are retrieved
UserData.description_zh: 用户自定义数据，获取结果时原样返回
